entries.claim: Historical English basis of the antiphon and the psalm verse (the Douay Prov 23:24–25 and Ps 83:2–3), revised against the Missal's Latin: rejoices with gladness, let Your Father and Your Mother be glad, let her who bore You rejoice, longs and faints, the contemporary address; the Gloria Patri is the closed formula with Holy Spirit, and the repeated antiphon takes the same revised wording.
